listing.name: WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 (WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 - PC Port)
listing.summary: Import your own Xbox 360 ISO of WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 with the Windows launcher. Steam Deck uses that player through Proton. A separate Android ARM64 app imports the same type of game image. The project’s Android hardware reports disagree.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Keep your own Xbox 360 ISO for the installer. The project does not identify an exact accepted disc hash or separate BIOS requirement.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the Windows player ZIP and its installer to import the game and choose optional music and movies. The Windows launcher handles updates. For Android ARM64, use the separate Vulkan APK and import your image there.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The README names a Galaxy Z Fold 7 test but also retains an older untested-phone statement. Portcove has not confirmed gameplay or qualified these packages.
